title: Record the 153-call zero remainder
body:
## Summary
- The selected one-unpaid idle mass is `1646 = 32*51 + 14` on each call. The least positive multiple of nine calls that clears that remainder is 153.
- At 153 calls the idle mass is `251838 = 4938*51`, with no remainder child, and the live width is 15232. Every smaller positive multiple of nine calls leaves a remainder. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. No moment is priced.
